scenario: Math constants per LEXP.4.1 and LIMP.3.3.4 — `math.pi`, `math.e` and `math.tau`, declared by `math`'s source, are inlined at compile time. tau = 2*pi. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete`'s `lgra_13_3_const`.
rules_ds:
import math

schema T scope logical:
    v: Float key

rule r_pi:
    T t where t.v > math.pi - 0.001 and t.v < math.pi + 0.001
->
    log critical "pi"

rule r_e:
    T t where t.v > math.e - 0.001 and t.v < math.e + 0.001
->
    log critical "e"

rule r_tau:
    T t where t.v > math.tau - 0.001 and t.v < math.tau + 0.001
->
    log critical "tau"
